crossRefs.note: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree…
To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there…
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

translations.web: The range of the mountains is his pasture, He searches after every green thing.
translations.bsb: He roams the mountains for pasture, searching for any green thing.
translations.kjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
translations.asv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.
